title: Fed Signals Potential Rate Cuts as Inflation Cools
summary: Federal Reserve officials suggest possible interest rate reductions in coming months as inflation metrics show continued moderation. Markets reacted positively to the dovish tone.

title: GDP Growth Surpasses Expectations in Q4
summary: Economic output expanded faster than forecasted, driven by strong consumer spending and business investment. Analysts revise upward projections for 2025.

title: Unemployment Rate Holds Steady at 3.7%
summary: Labor market remains tight with unemployment rate unchanged, indicating continued strength in job creation across multiple sectors.

title: CPI Rises 0.2% Month-Over-Month, Below Forecast
summary: Consumer price index increases at slower pace than expected, suggesting inflation continues to moderate toward Fed targets. Core inflation also decelerates.

title: Trade Deficit Widens Amid Strong Dollar
summary: Trade gap expands as strong US dollar impacts export competitiveness while imports remain robust. Manufacturing exports particularly affected.

title: Manufacturing PMI Shows Expansion for Third Consecutive Month
summary: Purchasing managers index indicates continued growth in manufacturing sector, signaling economic resilience despite headwinds.

title: Housing Starts Decline for Second Month
summary: New home construction drops as mortgage rates remain elevated, dampening builder confidence and housing market activity.

title: Consumer Confidence Index Reaches 18-Month High
summary: Survey shows consumers more optimistic about economic outlook and personal financial situation, supporting continued spending growth.
